# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel (31 Public Tools)
> Doctrine: Physics before narrative. Governed evidence only.
> Surface: generated from src/geox_mcp/tools_manifest.yaml

## 1. Canonical Tool Surface

1. **geox_well_ingest**: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
2. **geox_petrophysics**: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.
3. **geox_seismic_ingest**: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.
4. **geox_seismic_compute**: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.
5. **geox_seismic_interpret**: One semantic capability — propose geometry, physics-gate, compare hypotheses (NOT autonomous SEAL). Live modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, structure_validate, interpret (interpretation_bundle ≥3 hyps), interpret_section/rsi_pipeline (INT_SEISMIC), segy_slice. Gates return PASS|WARN|KILL|UNMEASURED + receipt_hash. preferred_hypothesis always null from GEOX. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.
6. **geox_basin**: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.
7. **geox_paleobiodb_query**: Query the Paleobiology Database (PBDB v1.2) for taxa, occurrences, and biozones. Modes: taxa (resolve a taxon), occurrence (fossil occurrence records), zone (biozones by scale), age_intervals (ICS / nanno / foram zones). Read-only, public-domain fossil data.
8. **geox_geomechanics**: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.
9. **geox_prospect**: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.
10. **geox_well_qc**: Quality control for well data: depth monotonicity, null %, physical range checks.
11. **geox_temporal**: Temporal analytics: decline curve, RRR, basin lifecycle, cadence. Modes: decline, rrr, basin_lifecycle, cadence.
12. **geox_map**: Map intelligence: layer discovery, scene composition, preview. Modes: layers_list, scene_plan, render_preview.
13. **geox_source**: Source rock & diagenesis: TOC, kerogen, maturity, compaction. Modes: source_rock, diagenesis.
14. **geox_spatial**: Spatial intelligence: H3, LanceDB, STAC. Modes: h3_index, lancedb_store, stac_discover.
15. **geox_deep_time**: Deep time: Earth state, dynamical systems, DDE reasoning. Modes: dde_reason.
16. **geox_claim**: Claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, falsify, synthesize, contradict. Modes: create, validate, challenge, seal, attach, falsify, discover, synthesize, abduct, contradict, scan.
17. **geox_model**: Geological modeling: subsurface inversion, 2D cross-sections, GemPy 3D. Modes: subsurface, geological_generate, gempy_3d.
18. **geox_well**: Well intelligence: view curves, open desk, desurvey. Modes: view, desk.
19. **geox_contrast_metabolize**: Unified anomalous contrast metabolic pipeline. Binds three stages into one call: ISOLATE (deterministic acoustic impedance contrast detection) then MEASURE (AVO gradient + LMR estimates) then CLASSIFY (>=3 stratigraphic trap hypotheses). substrate_class=INERT. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE - arifOS seals.
20. **geox_glof_cascade_initialize**: GLOF cascade simulation init. Accepts 33D GEOXEarthState33 (M9+P9+W9+X6 zen-33) or defaults to himalayan_glof_33. Returns session state_id.
21. **geox_glof_cascade_step**: Advance 33D GLOF state by n_steps. Uses metabolize_33 closure + forward_kinematics to derive W (Vp,Vs,alpha_B). Returns evolved 33D state.
22. **geox_glof_cascade_phase**: Yield surface eval on 33D state. Returns Mohr-Coulomb/Voellmy verdict + 33D-derived sigma_eff, tau_max, breach_probability_33D, hydro_fracture indicator.
23. **geox_glof_cascade_inverse**: Bayesian grid-search inference on 33D posterior from wave observations (W obs). Returns inferred theta_hat + log_likelihood + posterior_summary.
24. **geox_glof_cascade_metabolize**: Close F-I-M loop on 33D state. Emit FIMReceipt33 with tri-witness G-score, phase transitions, cycle_id.
25. **geox_glof_cascade_mcmc_inverse**: Phase C — proper Bayesian posterior via adaptive Metropolis-Hastings MCMC. Replaces grid search. Returns posterior mean, std, percentiles, R-hat, ESS, accept_rate, n_samples. Sampling on (E, c, phi, tau_0, sigma_t, phi_p).
26. **geox_glof_cascade_propagate**: Phase C — 1D Saint-Venant (shallow-water) wave propagation from breach to downstream. Lax-Friedrichs finite-volume solver with Manning friction. Returns time series of (h, u, Q) along domain + peak downstream Q/time/depth/velocity.
27. **geox_calibration_register_witness**: Register a CalibrationWitness for structural interpretation. Validates schema, checks completeness blockers (missing axes, depth-without-velocity). Returns VOID on bad input, HOLD on missing calibration.
28. **geox_extract_display_proxy**: Extract display-derived proxy from raster seismic image. Requires CalibrationWitness. Output labeled DISPLAY_DERIVED_PROXY — NOT suitable for AVO, amplitude preservation, or native well-tie.
29. **geox_register_native_source**: Register a native SEG-Y source for trace extraction. Validates file existence, computes SHA256, extracts binary header metadata. Authority downgrade: OPERATOR_APPROVED without actor → UNVERIFIED.
30. **geox_extract_native_trace**: Extract a native seismic trace from a registered source. Returns NativeTraceRef with full provenance. HOLD for unverified authority, restricted data, or missing source.
31. **geox_list_registered_sources**: List all registered native seismic sources with classification, authority, trace count, and sample metadata.

## 2. Agent Reasoning Logic
- Evidence before interpretation.
- Governance stays server-side.
- App-enabled workspace URI: `ui://geox/workspace-v1.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app).
